svg.title: The Tea Board: Blue-and-white export porcelain
svg.desc: The Tea Board (1D): the Company's parlour game, a trade-route board painted like blue-and-white porcelain. Eight ports joined by twelve lanes of three slots; solid cobalt Chests (Company) and white wave-marked Hymns (Alexi) contest each lane, and debt coins sit on a port. The tide dial stands at High, when Alexi may stir and push a Chest off its lane, as the arrow shows.
